summary: IATP remains one active 50/50 InfraBridge and Invenergy platform. ArcLight, through disclosed Gray Wolf entities, signed to acquire InfraBridge's half in March 2026, but no FERC authorization, consummation filing or party closing release was found by the as-of date, so InfraBridge remains active and ArcLight is pending incoming. DigitalBridge is a manager/control layer, not a separate direct owner.
